verdict.rationale: Fastmail exposes a JMAP API with API documentation (fastmail.com/dev) and protocol docs on jmap.io, but nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference or runnable examples. The OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404, so there is no evidence of a machine-readable spec that could back an interactive explorer. Static documentation is adjacent and does not deliver this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
